entities.name: Víctor Hugo Basabe
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Víctor Hugo Basabe is a Venezuelan prelate of the Catholic Church. He has been appointed the Metropolitan Archbishop of Coro. He was consecrated a bishop in 2016 and served five years as bishop of San Felipe and then from 2018 to 2023 was apostolic administrator Barquisimeto.
